decision_routes.inspect_or_repair_quality_failures: complete-video proof -> observability -> release safety -> bounded keep-best repair

sacred_guards: Publishing remains frozen until explicitly authorized.
A sovereign showrunner BLOCK remains BLOCK.
Do not alter WEIGHTS, AUTOFAIL_CHECKS, MIN_SCORE, decide_verdict, or fail-closed publishing to gain a pass.
Posted logs, uploader idempotency, OAuth/token routing, expected-channel guards, workflows, secrets, and production state are sacred.
Every phase is a separate commit with acceptance, stop, and rollback rules.
Baseline and shadow use identical slug, evidence, source data, narration, and metric definitions.
Unknown evidence remains unknown and synthetic evidence is not audience proof.
Channel identity and doctrine remain channel-owned.

declared_unverified: Professional Media OS declares 25 tests; Claude must execute them before adoption. Capability Studio, Advanced Capability Expansion, and subscription fallback suites must also be run in the current checkout.
